notes.title: Steam Achievements Added
notes.content:
Steam Achievements have now been added to the game! 

They are split between the standard and custom puzzle section and hopefully those of you who get them all will appreciate the visual style of the achievements icons  ;)

notes.title: Czech Language Support and Performance Improvements
notes.content:
The latest patch should improve CPU performance and adds Czech as a supported language to the game.

A big thank you and shout out to siSINka_CZ for providing the Czech fan translation.

notes.title: Unknown Pleasures: our five fave new Steam games
notes.content:
Welcome back to Unknown Pleasures, our weekly sift for lost gold amidst the fast-flowing waters of new Steam releases.

This week: typography shmups, comically exaggerated inventories, abstract jigsaws and CGA grindhouse shooters.
